[color=#00ff00][size=5][size=5][b]Clear Build Sites[/b][/size][/size][/color]

Are you tired of going all the way to Robin, choosing the perfect spot for a new building, and then finding out one tiny stone, twig, weed, or tree is in the way?

[b][size=4][color=#00ff00]Clear Build Sites[/color][/size][/b][size=4] [color=#00ffff]fixes[/color] that.[/size]

This mod lets the building placement screen automatically clear debris from the selected build site when placing a building. No more walking back home just to break one rock, chop one stick, or remove one weed before trying again.

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
